name: Enphase-Envoy-MQTT
description: Unraid packaging and configuration layer for vk2him/Enphase-Envoy-mqtt-json. Reads real-time data from an Enphase Envoy Gateway and publishes it to an MQTT broker. Includes optional Victron Cerbo GX / Venus OS integration examples.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent configuration and Enphase authentication token.

variables.name: MQTT Broker Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP address of the MQTT broker. For Victron Cerbo GX, enter the Cerbo GX IP address.

variables.name: MQTT Username
variables.description: MQTT username. Leave empty if authentication is not required.

variables.name: MQTT Password
variables.description: MQTT password. Leave empty if authentication is not required.

variables.name: MQTT Topic
variables.description: MQTT topic where the Envoy JSON data will be published.

variables.name: Envoy Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP address of the Enphase Envoy Gateway.

variables.name: Enphase Account Email
variables.description: Enphase Enlighten account email. Required for modern D7/D8 firmware authentication.

variables.name: Enphase Account Password
variables.description: Enphase Enlighten account password. Used to obtain or renew the local Envoy authentication token.

variables.name: Use HTTPS
variables.description: Use HTTPS when connecting to the Envoy. Recommended for recent firmware.

variables.name: Enphase Battery Installed
variables.description: Enable if the Enphase installation includes an Enphase battery.

variables.name: Debug
variables.description: Enable verbose debugging from the upstream application.
